id: title:dmarchuk:keep a young apns token instead of refreshing it after a rejection

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a shared Valkey cache and shared-write interval for accepted APNs keys, potentially reducing redundant shared-cache reads and improving performance for Apple Push Notification service token rejection handling.
review.reason: Adds a shared Valkey cache and shared-write interval for accepted APNs keys; the shared cache is only read when the token rejection is a provider-token rejection and the rejected token is young. The shared cache is not read for other failures.
review.uncertainty: The benefit of shared caching is inferred rather than demonstrated; no test or performance measurement is provided. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a caching mechanism, not on observed performance improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single group. No adoption, incident or effort is inferred. No tier is assigned.
